name: Cloudflare DNS & CDN Free
free_limit: Free authoritative DNS, CDN, universal SSL and DDoS protection
watch_out: Free provides authoritative DNS, basic CDN, universal SSL and DDoS protections for eligible zones; the free CDN is not website hosting. Zones created after September 2024 have lower record-count defaults (check the currently applicable DNS record cap); advanced performance/WAF features may require paid plans.
